params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-worktrees\integration-complete-mod-workflows-20260929-chatgpt'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune
git -C $repo worktree add $wt origin/integration/complete-mod-workflows-main-20260929
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\opencode-fallback.json'
$oc='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-tools\opencode\package\bin\opencode.exe'
Push-Location $wt
try {
 $prompt='Read AGENTS.md and current repository instructions. Reconcile origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows (cae2407e...) into this fresh current-main integration branch without replaying stale history. Preserve newer main behavior. Salvage all still-useful workflow functionality, especially missing FOMOD installer/UI, game adapter SDK, rules editor, update migration, workflow docs, richer collection recipe behavior, crash bisector improvements, SmartInbox/FOMOD hold behavior, workflow UI, conflict/deployment/storage changes, and relevant tests. Do not overwrite newer version, continuity, CI, or verification-state files with stale copies. Resolve conflicts semantically. Run relevant Release builds/tests. Commit the reconciled code/docs/tests to the current branch. Do not push. End with exact tests, limitations, and HEAD SHA.'
 & $oc run --standalone --auto --model 'ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b' --format json $prompt
 if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'LOCAL_AGENT_FAILED'}
 git status --short
 git log -5 --oneline
} finally {Pop-Location}
